function isIn(item, array)
  # Binary search to see if an item is in an array.
  # This works only if the array is sorted.
  iHigh = length(array)
  if iHigh = 0
     return false
  end
  iLow = 1
  while iLow < iHigh
     i = ⎿(iLow + iHigh) / 2⏌
     if item > array[i]
        iLow = i + 1
     else
        iHigh = i
     end
  end
  return (item = array[iLow])
end

function testFor(a, b)
   sum = 0
   for i in a:b
      sum = sum + i
   end
   return sum
end

function reverse(str)
   rev = ""
   for ch in str
      rev = ch & rev
   end
   return rev
end

function sumVec(V)
  sum = 0
  for el in V
    sum = sum + el
  end
  return sum
end

function testWhile(b)
   sum = 0
   i = 1
   while i <= b
      sum = sum + i
      i = i + 1
   end
   return sum
end

function testBreak()
   print "This is a print test."
   sum = 0
   for i in 1:100
      if i > 3
         break
      end
      sum = sum + i
   end
   return sum
end

function testThrow()
   sum = 0
   for i in 1:100
      if i > 3
         throw "Error."
      end
      sum = sum + i
   end
   return sum
end

function newton(f, fPrime, guess; ε = 1e-15)
x = guess
for i in 1:1000
    fx = f(x)
    if |fx| ≤ ε return x
    x = x - fx / fPrime(x)
end
throw "Error. Function did not converge."
end
